text: Firefox: typing '/' opens Quick Find (a hidden search bar that swallows keystrokes). If you type a URL or text containing '/', the '/' triggers Quick Find and the rest of the text vanishes. Always click the address bar first or use ds_type with target='Search with Google or enter address' to avoid this.
text_short: Firefox: '/' opens Quick Find — click address bar first
warn_text: STOP — Firefox Quick Find is open. Press Escape first, then click the address bar before typing a URL.
